answer: The Sybil defense is a stake-bonded identity ledger: every miner address must lock a fixed deposit that unlocks only after sustained, verifiable work. Running a lagoon of puppet accounts means posting that deposit for each one, so total capital scales linearly with the count of identities while reward per identity stays flat. A farm stops being a cheap oasis of clones and becomes a costly gamble. Attacker cost: N fake identities need N times the locked stake at risk, plus forfeiture when clustering is proven, so no safe haven of free aliases survives.
